title: Ukraine: Kyiv targets Krasnodar refineries after felling Kerch bridge
summary: Reports that two industrial facilities were targeted overnight in Krasnodar, after the Kerch bridge was put out of action by Ukrainian strikes.

image.caption: The Afipsky refinery is one of the refineries reported to have been targeted by Ukraine in overnight drone strikesImage: Vitaly Timkiv/TASS/dpa/picture alliance
